generation_method: Stratified bootstrap of authentic DSSAT feature vectors, followed by within-crop bootstrap sampling of observed-minus-DSSAT residuals. Rows are intentionally pseudo-data.

external_open_data_references.name: CIMMYT eastern India wheat field dataset (not Maharashtra ground truth)

limitations: Synthetic rows are resamples of the source dataset and do not increase independent sample size.
Residuals are bootstrapped from existing paired observations; they are not new measured outcomes.
No synthetic row has a verified DSSAT run for its complete row-specific inputs.
This file intentionally lacks production pairing provenance and must not be used for production training or accuracy claims.
It may be used for UI demonstrations, schema checks, and clearly labeled pipeline exercises only.
